title: Sycophancy Decay: Does the Model Stay Capitulated in Later Turns?

original_idea.body: After capitulation, continue neutral turns and re-ask; map recovery curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (durable vs transient capitulation harm) but catastrophic-risk link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: induce capitulation, re-ask later, map recovery curve; multi-turn prompting only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: capitulate then re-ask, recovery curve over turns.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public models, novel measured dynamic, weak lab incentive.
